Both clauses are verbless with prepositional predicates and noun-phrase subjects, so rule 53 (confirmed for a lexical-noun subject by rule 63) puts each supplied *be* on μετά, headed on the prepositional word. The ASV's *The Lord be* is precisely the word order rule 53 refuses to read a copula off.

τοῦ πνεύματός σου is emptied by rule 20 displacement, while ἡ before χάρις is unrepresented under rule 23 because the ASV writes a bare *Grace* — two different routes to an empty article in one verse.
